newsitem.title: USA: Duke shuts S.C. nuclear unit for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Duke shuts S.C. nuclear unit for repairs.

text.p: Duke Power Co shut its 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba 2 nuclear power plant over the weekend for repairs, the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commision (NRC) reported Monday.
The unit, in Clover, S.C., was shut on Saturday "to make repairs to the RHR (residual heat removal) system," the NRC said.
No estimate was given in the report on when the unit likely would be brought back on line and the operator was not immediately available for comment.
The neighboring unit, Catawba 1, was producing at full power after ending a brief repair outage last week. Catawba 1 production capacity is also rated at 1,129 MW.
